source.author: lucan
source.text: Erupere ducis sacro de pectore voces: Ergo pari voto gessisti bella, iuventus, Tu quoque pro dominis, et Pompeiana fuisti, Non Romana manus?
source.text_original: Erupere ducis sacro de pectore voces: / Ergo pari voto gessisti bella, iuventus, / Tu quoque pro dominis, et Pompeiana fuisti, / Non Romana manus?
source.text_english: Voices burst forth from the commander’s sacred breast: So, with the same resolve, you waged war, O youth; you too fought for lords, and were Pompeian, not a Roman band?

reuse.author: val
reuse.text: sed non et Scythici genitor discrimine nati intrepidus tales fundit Sol pectore voces:
reuse.text_original: sed non et Scythici genitor discrimine nati / intrepidus tales fundit Sol pectore voces: /
reuse.text_english: But the father of the Scythian son was not likewise fearless amid the danger, and the Sun pours forth such words from his heart:
